key.name: window-width
key.description: Last width of the main window, in logical pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Last height of the main window, in logical pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized when it was last closed.

key.name: vault-path
key.description: Absolute path of the configured journal; empty when none is configured.

key.name: auto-lock-minutes
key.description: Minutes of inactivity before the vault locks; 0 never locks.

key.name: lock-on-session-lock
key.description: Whether locking the session also locks the vault.
